articles.title: The quantum clock is ticking: it's Bitcoin's problem, not Ethereum's
articles.snippet: A recent research note published by Citi analysts reached a conclusion about quantum risk that should give every institutional bitcoin holder pause, Tabar explains.

articles.title: Prediction markets get first U.S. rule proposal as CFTC pursues contract reviews
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission opened a proposed rule for public comment that sets an approach to determine contracts in the "public interest."

articles.title: Michael Saylor gets into public debate over claims that Strategy's latest share sale was dilutive
articles.snippet: Strategy's BTC Yield fell from 13.0% to 12.8% following its latest bitcoin purchase, prompting a debate on X over whether the purchase was dilutive to shareholders.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO is four times oversubscribed. A crypto bet tells a more cautious story
articles.snippet: The SPCX perpetual still trades above SpaceX’s $135 offer price, but it has fallen sharply from its May highs as traders mark down the first-day premium.

articles.title: UK crypto advocates launch campaign against banks blocking exchange transfers
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK says banks are restricting access to regulated exchanges even as policymakers seek to position the country as a hub for digital asset innovation.
